parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is at 4 victory points, meaning she only needs one more point to win the game (the goal is 5 VP). She is currently offering 2 wood for 1 sheep. While 2:1 is a generous offer and I could use the wood to build roads towards a port (like the wood port at node 49), giving the leader the exact resource she is fishing for is extremely dangerous. A sheep would allow her to either build a settlement (if she acquires a brick) or buy a development card, which could be the winning victory point. Hadar has a 3:1 port at node 9 and access to brick on hex 5 (6), so she has multiple paths to victory if she gets that sheep. I must reject this trade to prevent her from winning immediately.
parsed.note_to_self: Hadar is at 4 VP and actively searching for a sheep and brick. I must block all trades that give her these resources. Shon is also a threat with his wheat production, but Hadar is at match point and is the immediate priority. I need wood and brick for my own expansion, but not at the cost of the game.
parsed.say_outloud: הדר, זה שקוף מדי. את ב-4 נקודות וכולנו יודעים ש-כבשה זה בדיוק מה שאת צריכה כדי לסגור עניין עם יישוב או קלף פיתוח. אני לא מתכוון להגיש לך את הניצחון על מגש של כסף, גם אם ההצעה של ה-עץ מפתה.
